_comment: One Zen visual effect turned off per variant, on top of the standard template. Switches come from docs/research/zen-effects-2026-10-12.md. 'scenarios' lists where the effect can cost something. Variants with no scenarios are memory settings for Firefox and Zen alike, which m1-batches skips and the memory batch runs on idle.

no-vibrancy.what: native window material (ZenWindowMaterialView) replaced by a plain view

no-page-radius.what: rounded corners of the floating page

no-squircle.what: squircle corner shapes across the UI

reduced-motion.what: Reduce Motion as the system setting would set it (many animations at once). Not in the effects batch: it also changes what every website sees, so Origin would not ship it

no-native-popovers.what: native NSPopover arrow panels (Zen turns them on; Firefox ships them off)

min-visual.what: every effect above off at once, except reduced-motion: the lower bound for Zen's look

vibrancy-and-radius-off.what: window material and rounded page mask both off: tells whether the two costs add up or one hides the other (docs/research/window-material-2026-10-13.md)

no-wr-compositor.what: control for bug 1574586: WebRender draws one window-sized surface instead of native layers, so WindowServer should rise in Zen and Firefox alike

small-surface-pool.what: native compositor surface pool of 4 instead of 25 spare IOSurfaces: less GPU memory, more IOSurface allocations while scrolling (docs/research/gpu-memory-retina-2026-10-13.md)

release-idle-buffers.what: native compositor tiles drop their spare buffer after 10 composites without a redraw (src/gfx/webrender_bindings/RenderCompositorNative-cpp.patch); the spares go to the surface pool

idle-buffers-small-pool.what: release-idle-buffers with a surface pool of 4, so the spares are really freed

on-demand.what: only the selected tab loads at startup, as Firefox ships it for normal tabs, and pinned tabs wait too: what unloading background tabs leaves

lean-memory.what: on-demand plus no spare content processes (Firefox keeps 3 ready) and no preloaded new tab page

unload-1min.what: Origin's tab unloader at 1 minute: the idle scenario settles 150 s, so it measures memory after background tabs unload

idle-trim-1min.what: Origin's idle cache trim at 1 minute: one memory-pressure notification after a minute without input, so the idle scenario measures memory after WebRender drops its caches

quiet-newtab.what: Firefox's new tab machinery kept as quiet as prefs allow: blank homepage and new tab page, the 12 low-risk widget feeds and the wallpaper fetch off (docs/research/newtab-2026-10-13.md)
